answer: What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nebula of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
